propositions: Canonical preview must produce a single manifest containing arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from one ordinary dry-run differ pass without launching or reimplementing reconcile-check.
Canonical preview must execute lock-free without acquiring, purging, stealing, or writing pass locks while maintaining coherent read-only snapshot semantics.
Argparse must use allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations like --dry-run before any repository or lock mutation, while documented options like --mode dry-run remain valid.
Legacy reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair behavior, diagnostic JSON artifact, and lock-free execution unchanged.
Canonical preview and canonical sync must expose the same field-comparable manifest envelope, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain the historical tally-only no-retained-manifest contract.
Canonical preview reads the active local-ticket set once and does not duplicate a second comparison pass or invoke reconcile-check.
